ODFL.note: ODFL's first XBRL 10-K is for fiscal 2010, so the SEC's data reaches back only to 2008, its earliest comparative year. Fiscal 2007 is read from the statement of operations in the 10-K for fiscal 2009, the latest 10-K that reports it; its 2008 and 2009 columns must equal the XBRL series, so 2007 sits on the same basis.
